title: Native runtime candidates for the first native retained-information witness (preparation; no outcomes)
objective: Identify the smallest REAL native runtime in this repository (not the slice001 finite toy, not a rename of it) that natively retains information across a named boundary, and design its witness to the point of preregistration.
problem: Plan s7.1: one actual native retained-information witness, clean allowed-state twin, delayed-leak reset and separate world-side oracle; native scheduling/readout/observer contracts actually exercised. Survey at least 3 candidates among runtimes that exist and run here (organisms, engines, agents in this repo); for each: what it retains natively, the named boundary, the allowed channel, how a delayed-leak reset and a clean allowed-state twin are constructed, the world-side oracle kept separate from the ruler, what the adapter must emit (canonical receipt bytes + ledger rows via rso.binding only, BX6), estimated CPU and wall cost, and the risk it collapses into the toy. Recommend one with reasons and a fallback. DESIGN_DRAFT: claims, positive and negative controls, predicates, expected outcome classes (positive / negative / detection-unqualified), budget. Preparation only: you may import/build/smoke a candidate to check it runs, but do NOT compute any witness predicate or look at retention outcomes before preregistration (directive s11).
non_goals: No change to world predicates, the expected-answer table or S2 case expectations
No scheduler, no universal state/cognition schema (CONTRACT.md BX6, s5)
C-004 records and freezes are not rewritten
evidence_required: CANDIDATES.md with >= 3 real candidates and a recommendation
a statement of what was run (smoke only) and what was not

acceptance.command: python -B -m unittest discover -s rso/slice001/tests -t . && python -B -m unittest discover -s rso/binding/tests -t .
acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; both suites green
